media.scoped_media: CREATE TABLE scoped_media(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,mime TEXT NOT NULL,sha TEXT NOT NULL,bytes BLOB NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL)
media.image_analysis: CREATE TABLE image_analysis(id TEXT,owner TEXT,result TEXT,at INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(id,owner))
media.image_sends: CREATE TABLE image_sends(owner TEXT,id TEXT,event TEXT,at INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(owner,id,event))

workroom.wr_projects: CREATE TABLE wr_projects(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scope TEXT,title TEXT,origin TEXT,head INTEGER,deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,created TEXT,updated TEXT)
workroom.wr_versions: CREATE TABLE wr_versions(project TEXT,version INTEGER,files TEXT,digest TEXT,reason TEXT,at TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(project,version))
workroom.wr_releases: CREATE TABLE wr_releases(project TEXT PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER,title TEXT,origin TEXT,publisher TEXT,at TEXT)
workroom.wr_tasks: CREATE TABLE wr_tasks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scope TEXT,title TEXT,brief TEXT,state TEXT,project TEXT,result TEXT,updated TEXT)
workroom.wr_submissions: CREATE TABLE wr_submissions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project TEXT,version INTEGER,task TEXT,summary TEXT,checks TEXT,state TEXT,at TEXT)
workroom.wr_hidden: CREATE TABLE wr_hidden(project TEXT PRIMARY KEY,at TEXT)
workroom.wr_checks: CREATE TABLE wr_checks(project TEXT,version INTEGER,result TEXT,at TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(project,version))
